findings.rationale: Changed the overview's initial 'énergie sûre' wording to 'approvisionnement énergétique fiable' so dependable supply is not silently recast as a safety finding. Capacité nominale, état de charge and répartition retain the technical distinctions with the latter defined in the text. Application de la réglementation preserves enforcement rather than treating it as an operating-success claim. Asset availability, customer interruptions and modeled savings remain separate.

Capacidad nominal, estado de carga, interconexión and despacho retain the engineering distinctions; despacho is explicitly defined. Aplicación de la normativa preserves enforcement, puesta en servicio remains distinct from receiving-system acceptance, and reducción de la producción preserves curtailment. No named-asset observation is generalized to grid or customer performance.
